title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag integrates Claude into Slack with inline responses and context preservation, enabling teams to automate synthesis tasks. Marketing reduced a 15-message thread into polished documentation in 45 minutes, while product operations found 24 relevant customer accounts in 26 minutes instead of a week manually. Legal review turnaround dropped from days to 30 minutes, demonstrating Claude's ability to handle synthesis while humans retain judgment on accuracy.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp developed a two-skill architecture for self-improving Claude agents: an inner skill holding domain knowledge and an outer improver skill observing feedback to propose refinements. Skills are file-based to enable standard code-review workflows, addressing the common issue that initial prompts reach only 80% accuracy. This pattern is applied across Warp's spec-writing, code-review, and issue-triage agents.

title: Claude's Memory works everywhere, and you decide what's in it
summary: Unified memory now works across Claude chat and Claude Cowork, retaining information about users and preferences with real-time updates during conversations. A transparent Topics interface lets users view, edit, and delete saved information, with sensitive topics excluded by default. Context set in chat automatically carries over to Cowork outputs.

title: Bain & Company joins the Claude Partner Network as a Global Premier Partner
summary: Anthropic and Bain & Company formalize a strategic partnership with Bain joining as a Global Premier member of the Claude Partner Network. Bain deployed Claude to its 19,000-person workforce with 7,000+ actively using it within weeks, achieving 30-50% productivity gains on legacy code modernization. Bain now offers combined Claude technology and consulting expertise to enterprise clients.

title: How an Anthropic field marketer uses Claude Code to send weekly personalized updates to every sales rep
summary: Anthropic's field marketer automated personalized weekly sales-rep briefings using Claude Code to pull and synthesize data from BigQuery, HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, blog posts, and customer stories. The system eliminated a manual Sunday-night process, now runs autonomously, and has expanded to customer success and alliance teams with measurable impact like doubled event registrations. It demonstrates hands-off deployment of Claude Code across non-engineering teams.

title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude's Chrome extension is now generally available for all paid plan users, allowing Claude to view pages and take autonomous actions without manual approval. The extension includes enhanced prompt-injection defenses through model training improvements and automated verification, with testing showing near-zero attack success rates. This enables seamless Claude integration for websites without native integrations.
